content.short: Origin Ether (OETH) combines yield-generating functions of Lido, Rocket Pool, and Frax.
content.description: Origin Ether (OETH) is an ETH LST that consolidates yield-generating strategies from Lido, Rocket Pool, and Frax into a single diversified token. By deploying ETH and the LSTs across multiple blue-chip protocols, it aims to generate robust yields within the DeFi space. This approach provides a unified, simplified way to access a blended set of staking and liquidity-generation opportunities across ecosystems. OETH holders receive daily yield via a positive rebase directly into their wallets, with rewards credited automatically to their balances.
